data.title: A Slavic magnate's court – a reconstruction drawing
data.excerpt: Tomáš Humaj has drawn a very fine and at the same time realistic impression of a fortified Slavic manorial court for our site. It depicts no specific fortlet, but the appearance of the defences, the palisade and the buildings bring the life of our ancestors in the 9th and 10th centuries closer to us.
data.metaTitle: A Slavic magnate's court – a drawing
data.metaDescription: A realistic drawing of a fortified Slavic magnate's court by Tomáš Humaj: the defences, the palisade and the buildings of the 9th and 10th centuries.

mediaTexts.alt: A drawing of a magnate's court with a palisade, log buildings and a watchtower

children.text: Our collaborator Tomáš Humaj has drawn a very fine and at the same time realistic impression of a fortified Slavic manorial court for our site. It is not any specific fortlet, but the appearance of the defences, the palisade and the buildings are very realistic and once again bring the life of our ancestors in the period of the 9th/10th century closer to us.
